statement: Independently audited and kernel-checked core: if 9/23<theta<1 satisfies the source short-prime input PI(theta), then every fixed 0<c<(1-theta)/3 gives, for all sufficiently large k and every 2k<n<=exp(c(log k)^2/loglog k), a prime divisor p in (k,k+3k^theta) of (n-k)...(n-1), hence p in (k,2k); theta=21/40 gives every c<19/120. The balanced four-range class has the exact theta window 9/23<theta<1. Post-promotion natural-proof extension, separately reconstructed by a same-model Codex auditor but not yet Lean-checked or externally audited: adaptive upper thresholds and unbalanced lambda extend the same PI(theta)-conditional attaining theorem to every 0<theta<1, while the explicitly defined location-blind adaptive subdivided Konyagin little-o certificate class still cannot reach c>=(1-theta)/3. This enlarged barrier assumes a partition of the deterministic PI-cardinality tail and independent summation of nonnegative Konyagin bounds; it excludes prime-location-adaptive sparse covers, cross-block cancellation, stronger local prime input, and direct estimates of the true bad set. The BHP constant remains 19/120.

dependency_gaps: The abstract theta theorem assumes PI(theta); the theta=21/40 corollary imports the Baker--Harman--Pintz short-prime input exactly as the source paper does.

The complete four-range ParametricRangeBuilder and final conditional theorem are kernel-checked in Lean for 9/23<theta<1. The adaptive unbalanced extension to 0<theta<=9/23 and its enlarged certificate barrier have natural proofs and a separate same-model cross-reconstruction, but still require Lean formalization and external independent review before the inherited formal status can be extended.

The enlarged no-go is confined to a location-blind deterministic-tail partition whose nonnegative Theorem 4.1 bounds are summed and required to be o(k^theta/log k). It does not cover sparse covers selected from actual prime locations, cross-block cancellation, stronger prime inputs, stronger exponential-sum estimates, or the true bad-set cardinality.
Novelty and publication priority remain unchecked.
